verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior major findings. The documentation now accurately labels uniform anonymous 403 handling as a known non-conformance for an LDP resource-serving path and states that the resource server must supply the authentication-aware 401 plus WWW-Authenticate lane. The new sparq-server unit test exercises the shipped deny_status_code function directly for both definitive statuses and both anonymous/authenticated decisions, while the sparq-solid test is now explicitly and accurately scoped to the library-level AclStatus/is_retryable contract rather than claiming to test the HTTP shell. The changes are internally consistent with the documented architecture boundary and introduce no apparent correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect.
